verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Babylon.js is a real-time WebGL/WebGPU rendering engine with a Node Material Editor and native glTF PBR material import, implying baseline PBR support, but the pack contains no explicit documentation of shadow mapping, global illumination/baked lighting, or a post-processing pipeline. Community threads praise visual quality and demos but don't confirm these specific pipeline features either. Missing for 10: explicit shadow system docs, GI/lightmapping baked-lighting docs, post-process stack documentation, and independent corroboration of PBR material fidelity.
